title: 阿科松博水壩
summary: 本課以以阿科松博土石壩廣域湖泊與發電放流界面學習為主線，先用堆石濕陷與水位與合成核心應力轉移界定水力與構造條件，再將共用設備與可用率、廣域湖面與庫容連結到枯水容量與年能量。業主確認壩型與建設年代；公開頁高度長度互有矛盾故不採用，下列工程數值全為教學假設。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
summaryEn: This course develops studying Akosombo embankment lake storage and generation-release interfaces through Rockfill wetting and settlement and Synthetic core stress transfer, then connects Shared equipment and availability and Broad lake surface and storage to Drought capacity and annual energy. The owner confirms dam type and construction dates; conflicting published heights and lengths are excluded and all lesson engineering values are hypothetical. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「堆石濕陷與水位」與「合成核心應力轉移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rockfill wetting and settlement" and "Synthetic core stress transfer": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 堆石濕陷與水位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rockfill wetting and settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堆石濕陷與水位」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rockfill wetting and settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石壩蓄水可能改變顆粒接觸與破碎，濕潤後變形需與施工壓實沉陷分開。平均軸向應變乘厚度只估均勻壓縮量，不能代表整壩三維沉陷；應以分區材料試驗與蓄水前後測點反應建立對照，避免只看壩頂總量。 驗證時應比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎，並辨識以下失效情境：濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堆石濕陷與水位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wetting can change rockfill contacts and breakage, and its deformation should be separated from construction settlement. Mean axial strain times thickness describes uniform compression only, not the three-dimensional dam. Compare zoned material tests with pre- and postimpoundment markers rather than relying on crest settlement alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rockfill wetting and settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堆石濕陷與水位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rockfill wetting and settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堆石濕陷與水位
knowledge.text: 堆石壩蓄水可能改變顆粒接觸與破碎，濕潤後變形需與施工壓實沉陷分開。平均軸向應變乘厚度只估均勻壓縮量，不能代表整壩三維沉陷；應以分區材料試驗與蓄水前後測點反應建立對照，避免只看壩頂總量。
knowledge.textEn: Wetting can change rockfill contacts and breakage, and its deformation should be separated from construction settlement. Mean axial strain times thickness describes uniform compression only, not the three-dimensional dam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堆石濕陷與水位」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rockfill wetting and settlement" is correct?
options: 所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成
堆石壩蓄水可能改變顆粒接觸與破碎，濕潤後變形需與施工壓實沉陷分開。
平均覆土應力高就保證核心各方向應力都高
optionsEn: Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction
Wetting can change rockfill contacts and breakage, and its deformation should be separated from construction settlement.
High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction
quiz.explanation: 堆石壩蓄水可能改變顆粒接觸與破碎，濕潤後變形需與施工壓實沉陷分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wetting can change rockfill contacts and breakage, and its deformation should be separated from construction settlement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堆石濕陷與水位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rockfill wetting and settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「堆石濕陷與水位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rockfill wetting and settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堆石濕陷與水位」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rockfill wetting and settlement", which statement holds?
options: 總洩量相同就表示所有閘門組合效果相同
裝置容量就是任何水頭下都能維持的出力
原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。
optionsEn: Equal total release means every gate combination has the same effect
Nameplate capacity is output that can be maintained at every head
Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: SyntheticLayerThickness=40 m; prescribedWettingStrain=0.004; uniformSettlement=40*0.004=0.16 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堆石濕陷與水位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rockfill wetting and settlement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「堆石濕陷與水位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rockfill wetting and settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堆石濕陷與水位」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rockfill wetting and settlement"?
options: 比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
靜水位低於壩頂就保證不會有波浪越頂
optionsEn: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Still water below the crest guarantees no wave overtopping
quiz.explanation: 比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堆石濕陷與水位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rockfill wetting and settlement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「堆石濕陷與水位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rockfill wetting and settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。診斷時應採取以下查核：比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有蓄水後沉陷都只是施工壓實尚未完成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every postimpoundment settlement merely reflects unfinished construction compaction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。診斷時應採取以下查核：比對分層沉陷與濕潤前緣孔壓時序並核對材料破碎，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare layered settlement with wetting-front pressure histories and material breakage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堆石濕陷與水位」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rockfill wetting and settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。
平均覆土應力高就保證核心各方向應力都高
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell.
High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction
quiz.explanation: 濕陷集中於局部區帶可能增加核心與壩殼相對變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Localized wetting settlement can increase differential movement between core and shell. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 合成核心應力轉移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Synthetic core stress transfer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「合成核心應力轉移」如何影響阿科松博水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synthetic core stress transfer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Akosombo Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 合成土石壩核心與兩側材料剛度不同時，拱效應可能把部分豎向荷載轉移到較硬區，降低核心局部總應力。單一有效應力差只呈現孔壓餘量，不能直接預報水力劈裂；需評估最小主應力、材料拉伸特性與接觸變形。 驗證時應比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差，並辨識以下失效情境：用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「合成核心應力轉移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a synthetic zoned dam, stiffness contrast can transfer vertical load away from the core. A scalar effective-stress difference illustrates pressure margin but does not predict hydraulic fracture. Evaluate minimum principal stress, tensile behavior and interface deformation instead of treating average overburden as the complete stress state. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Synthetic core stress transfer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa。

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.textEn: In a synthetic zoned dam, stiffness contrast can transfer vertical load away from the core. A scalar effective-stress difference illustrates pressure margin but does not predict hydraulic fracture.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均覆土應力高就保證核心各方向應力都高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「合成核心應力轉移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Synthetic core stress transfer" is correct?
options: 平均覆土應力高就保證核心各方向應力都高
料場試驗合格就保證每個鋪築界面都合格
合成土石壩核心與兩側材料剛度不同時，拱效應可能把部分豎向荷載轉移到較硬區，降低核心局部總應力。
optionsEn: High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction
Passing stockpile tests guarantees every placed interface is acceptable
In a synthetic zoned dam, stiffness contrast can transfer vertical load away from the core.
quiz.explanation: 合成土石壩核心與兩側材料剛度不同時，拱效應可能把部分豎向荷載轉移到較硬區，降低核心局部總應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a synthetic zoned dam, stiffness contrast can transfer vertical load away from the core. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 合成核心應力轉移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synthetic core stress transfer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「合成核心應力轉移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Synthetic core stress transfer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

閘門數量多就保證沒有任何共同失效點

A large number of gates guarantees no common failure point

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: PrescribedNormalTotalStress=500 kPa; porePressure=350 kPa; effectiveNormalStress=500-350=150 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 合成核心應力轉移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synthetic core stress transfer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合成核心應力轉移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Synthetic core stress transfer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合成核心應力轉移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Synthetic core stress transfer"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差。
每天總放流量相同就表示下游影響完全相同
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones.
Equal daily release volume guarantees identical downstream effects
quiz.explanation: 比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合成核心應力轉移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Synthetic core stress transfer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合成核心應力轉移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Synthetic core stress transfer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均覆土應力高就保證核心各方向應力都高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High average overburden guarantees high stress in every core direction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較核心內應力與孔壓並檢查相鄰材料變形差，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare core stress and pore pressure with deformation differences in adjacent zones. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合成核心應力轉移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Synthetic core stress transfer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
料場試驗合格就保證每個鋪築界面都合格
用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Passing stockpile tests guarantees every placed interface is acceptable
Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress.
quiz.explanation: 用平均覆土重量代替局部最小應力可能漏掉劈裂敏感區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Average overburden can conceal regions with low local minimum stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
